Preprocessing
   Reading file: C:\Program Files (x86)\Inno Setup 6\ISPPBuiltins.iss
Error on line 27 in D:\a\VIRA-Accounting-App\VIRA-Accounting-App\installer\vira.iss: Column 47:
Undeclared identifier: Chr.
Compile aborted.

root_cause: ISPP preprocessor does not provide Pascal Chr; use literal doubled quotes in conditional Inno entry fields. No payload/runtime or expected hashes changed.
